components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen, such as New category or Save.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 80%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions in a row, such as Edit and Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 500 0.8rem/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: The final confirm button in a delete, refund, or reject dialog. Never directly in a list row.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); color: #fff; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 90%); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 40%); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled input with its error linked below.
components.html: Category name already exists
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-label { font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(1 0 0); font: 400 1rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.556 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); } .ds-error { margin: 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sidebar links: Slate Text when inactive, Hairline background when active.
components.html: DashboardCategoriesFiles
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 192px; padding: 16px; background: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 0.875rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 50%); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-active { background: oklch(0.922 0 0); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 420px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); font: 500 0.875rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-row:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-indent { padding-left: 40px; } .ds-thumb { width: 40px; height: 40px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(1 0 0); font: 500 0.8rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-btn:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-more { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); cursor: pointer; } .ds-more:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-row-btn:focus-visible, .ds-more:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0); }

narrative.overview:
Store Admin is the room behind the shop. Staff come in to confirm a payment, fix a price, or add a category, and they leave. The interface stays neutral so that any store can run it under its own name, and quiet so that the one thing that needs attention, an error, a destructive action, the current page, is the only thing that speaks.

The system is shadcn/ui's neutral theme, owned and tuned for use on a phone. It is achromatic by design: the store's identity lives in its storefront, not here. Restraint is the brand. Quality shows in precise details instead: 44px touch targets on phones, aligned figures, a visible focus ring, and errors placed beside the field they describe.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic neutrals, with red reserved for danger.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines, not shadows.
Phone first: 44px controls below `md`, the desktop density from `md` up.
One page title, then content; no decorative headers.
Feedback for every action: a status line while loading, a toast on success, a message beside the field on error.

rules.name: The Red Means Stop Rule
rules.body: Alarm Red appears only where something can go wrong or is irreversible: Delete, Refund, Reject, Cancel, and error text. It is never decoration, a brand accent, or a status for something that is fine.

rules.name: The No Store Color Rule
rules.body: The admin carries no store's brand color. A store's identity reaches the admin only through `VITE_STORE_NAME`.

rules.name: The Aligned Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that can sit above or beside another number, such as page counts, file sizes, money, and quantities, uses tabular figures (`tabular-nums`).

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits in the page is flat. Only things that float above it, such as dialogs, menus, and sheets, get depth.

dos: **Do** keep every tappable control at least 44px tall below `md` (768px).
**Do** use one primary button per screen, and outline or ghost buttons for everything else.
**Do** put a destructive action behind a menu or a confirmation dialog, and use solid Alarm Red only on the final confirm button.
**Do** show the backend's error message next to the field it names, and link it with `aria-describedby`.
**Do** use `tabular-nums` for any number that can align with another.
**Do** separate rows and regions with Hairline borders instead of shadows.
donts: **Don't** add a store's brand color, logo color, or any second accent to the admin.
**Don't** use Alarm Red for anything that is not an error or a destructive action.
**Don't** add shadows to things that sit in the page, such as rows, cards, and the sidebar.
**Don't** show three or more equal-weight buttons on a list row; move the extra actions into the "More actions" menu.
**Don't** invent figures, stat tiles, or sample data to fill an empty screen.
